author: GamingBolt
description:
We’ve had some time with Marvel’s Wolverine, and we’re happy to share our impressions of how it performs from a visual and technical perspective. Of course, comparisons between how it does on the base PS5 versus the more powerful and better equipped PS5 Pro are inevitable, as are questions about how it can measure up against Insomniac’s widely popular take on Spider-Man.

Well, we’ve sat down to lay it all out for you in case you’re thinking of joining in on the carnage when this one comes out next week. Join us as we give you some good news on that front, and perhaps help you decide if this is the game you’re going for in a month of some really good releases competing for your attention. On the graphical side of things, that is.
title: Marvel's Wolverine PS5 Pro vs PS5 Graphics Comparison - Insomniac's Best Looking PS5 Game Yet?

author: GamingBolt
description:
I thoroughly enjoyed my time with Wolverine, and while the complete campaign can be wrapped up in roughly 20 hours, the journey is consistently memorable and packed with moments that stick with you. 

We haven’t had a truly great Wolverine game in what feels like forever, with 2009’s X-Men Origins: Wolverine immediately coming to mind, but Insomniac’s take on the angry mutant may very well represent the character’s pinnacle in terms of presentation and story-telling.
It’s violent and surprisingly heartfelt, and about as close to the definitive Wolverine experience as you could hope for.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Who would have guessed that we'd have to wait over seven years for a new Gears of War entry? Since Gears 5 in 2019, the series has effectively been on ice, but as it turns out, The Coalition was actually going back to basics. Enter Gears of War: E-Day, launching on October 6th for PC and Xbox Series X/S as a console exclusive, which takes us back to where it all truly began: Emergence Day.

But don't let this fool you into thinking that the gameplay hasn't evolved. If anything, E-Day is the most ambitious title in the series yet, with its sweeping changes. Join us as we delve into the 15 biggest differences between it and Gears 5.
title: Gears of War E-Day vs. Gears 5 - WHAT'S NEW?
